conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: B shows each case's scope, constraint, and supplied outcome directly on the page, so a director working under a 4-minute budget can evaluate fit without clicking; A collapses both cases and all three process stages, so the landing view offers only two project names and three stage labels. B also carries the supplied/not-supplied distinction per case and in a dedicated disclosure block, while A's process disclosures open to filler sentences that add no information. On the contact action, B's validation wires per-field messages through aria-describedby and its submit copy claims nothing (reproduced locally), whereas A shows one generic message per field with no programmatic association and closes with 'Request sent. Mara will follow up directly about next steps.'
suspected_unblinding: none — B's source carries zone/element codes (data-elem, C1/E1/P0) suggesting a more structured build method, but that identifies a method, not a treatment, and did not drive the choice

unsupported_claims.label: A
unsupported_claims.claim: Submit success text asserts the request was sent and that the designer will follow up — a delivery and response commitment not supplied by the brief

unsupported_claims.label: B
unsupported_claims.claim: Each case's 'Before' beat asserts the client had no identity, wayfinding, poster system, or signage beforehand — a prior-condition claim not supplied

findings.label: A
findings.description: All case-study substance is hidden behind collapsed accordions, so the default view offers no evaluable work for the stated 4-minute decision.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png and A/mobile.png show only 'Harbor Room' and 'Night School' rows; A/source/index.html case-detail divs carry hidden

findings.label: A
findings.description: Expanding a process stage reveals only a restatement of its position in the sequence, so the required 'inspect the process' interaction yields no information.
findings.evidence: A/source/index.html lines 125-160: panels read 'The first of three stages, before system proposal.' / 'The third and final stage of the process.'

findings.label: A
findings.description: Inline validation errors are never associated with their inputs, so a screen-reader user hears an invalid field with no reason.
findings.evidence: Reproduced by serving A/source on localhost and submitting the empty form in Playwright: every input reports aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby=null; A/source/app.js setFieldError sets no describedby

findings.label: A
findings.description: Success copy claims the request was transmitted and that the designer will follow up, neither of which is supplied or true of a static build.
findings.evidence: Reproduced: status text after a valid submit reads 'Request sent. Mara will follow up directly about next steps.' (A/source/app.js line 64)

findings.label: A
findings.description: Per-field error copy authored in the markup ('Enter your organization.') is dead code — the script overwrites every field with the same generic string.
findings.evidence: A/source/index.html lines 182-198 vs app.js line 50; A/evidence/state-01-contact-form-validation-error.png shows 'This field is required.' three times

findings.label: B
findings.description: Each case invents the client's prior condition ('no visual identity, no gallery wayfinding'; 'no season identity, poster system, or venue signage'), which the brief does not supply.
findings.evidence: B/source/index.html lines 47-50 and 102; visible in B/desktop.png Before beats

findings.label: B
findings.description: The Mechanism beat is inconsistent between cases: case 01 describes the three-stage process, case 02 restates a constraint under the same label.
findings.evidence: B/desktop.png Night School 'MECHANISM — Constraint: posters had to work in a single ink.' (B/source/index.html line 106)

findings.label: B
findings.description: The page has no h1; the document starts at h2, so the top-level document title exists only in the masthead paragraph.
findings.evidence: Reproduced heading dump from the served page: H2 'See the work', H3 'Harbor Room', ... H2 'Decide whether to reach out'

findings.label: B
